business.summary: Low-cost, high-volume multi-specialty hospital group founded by cardiac surgeon Dr Devi Prasad Shetty. India: 20 hospitals and heart centres (owned, or operated under rental/revenue-share agreements with trusts) in six clusters, plus 20 clinics and dialysis centres. Overseas: Health City Cayman Islands (two hospitals, 164 beds, US-dollar revenue) with its own insurer (CIHL), and since 6-Nov-2025 the UK's Practice Plus Group hospitals (13 facilities, 330 beds, ~95% NHS-funded). India also has a health insurer (NHIL), clinics (NHIC) and software units (Athma, Medha).

guidance.said: Base case: UK ROCE of 20-22% by FY29-30; PPG's FY25 EBITDA was £20 mn pre-IFRS 16 and £29 mn post-IFRS 16.
guidance.outcome: Too early: management said in Aug-2026 it can report UK ROCE 'maybe four quarters from now'

guidance.said: ₹3,000 cr of India projects; FY27 plan ₹460 cr greenfield + ₹270 cr maintenance; ~₹1,000 cr a year in FY28-29. FY26 greenfield spend was ₹109 cr vs ₹424 cr planned (election-related labour shortages, permissions).
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27: ₹74.5 cr greenfield + ₹31.4 cr maintenance; three projects pushed back a year in the Aug-2026 deck

guidance.said: FY26's ~20% reported margin carries UK one-time acquisition costs; normalised 'slightly over 22%' is the base to improve on (no formal guidance).
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27 17.5% (ex-other income): UK heatwave, insurance losses

guidance.said: Cash burn to continue at a similar run rate in FY27; plan to double clinics, Kolkata in FY27; clinics reported within hospitals from FY27.
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27 clinic loss ~₹15 cr; two clinics opening in Q2

guidance.said: Losses for 'another quarter or two' in the Q4 range (~US$5 mn), then down significantly over ~3 quarters as 30-35% of accounts reprice from June; loss ratio ~110-112%.
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27 loss US$3.7 mn; July renewals 100% retained at higher prices

guidance.said: Double-digit quarterly growth 'not physically possible' to sustain; growth slows; no additional Cayman capex.
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27 hospital revenue +5% YoY in US$

guidance.said: Rack-rate increases 'hover in the low to mid single digits'; ARPOB growth from shorter stays and payer mix to continue; occupancy 'typically 60-65%' (not reported).
No meaningful bed additions for 2-3 years, so core margin expands with operating leverage; how much is passed to patients or reinvested (integrated care) is a choice.
Target ALOS of 3.9-4.0 days (4.3 in Q1FY27).

Net debt/EBITDA below 1x; debt rises for 2-3 years as construction picks up, then lower than today by FY30. Cash on hand to be deployed into the ₹3,000 cr committed over two years, part own funds, part borrowing.
guidance.outcome: Net debt ₹1,967 cr at Jun-26 (₹2,240 cr at Mar-26)

guidance.said: Heatwave cost operating days (some into Q2); separation from the seller done; software certification 4-6 months later than planned; payer-mix shift from ~95% NHS over 4-5 years.

history.event: Dr Devi Prasad Shetty incorporates Narayana Hrudayalaya in Bengaluru; first facility ~225 beds (Narayana Institute of Cardiac Sciences)
Expansion into Kolkata (RTIICS), East and Central India, many hospitals run for trusts and governments on rental/revenue-share terms
history.impact: Operated hospitals are ~25% of India hospital revenue today

history.event: Bonus issue (19.97 cr shares) and conversion of optionally convertible debentures (43.6 lakh shares)
IPO; listed on NSE and BSE
Health City Cayman Islands (East End) built in the Cayman Islands as a US-dollar, cash-and-insurance hospital; Health City Camana Bay added, which with the group insurer drove FY26 growth
history.impact: Cayman hospital revenue US$110 mn (FY23) → US$179 mn (FY26); Cayman is ~a quarter of group revenue

history.event: Integrated care: NH Integrated Care clinics (Bengaluru), Narayana Health Insurance (India) and Cayman Integrated Healthcare (insurer; selling from Jan-2025)
history.impact: Losses of ₹32 cr (FY24) → ₹139 cr (FY26) across clinics and the two insurers

accounting.ebitdaBasis: Company 'EBITDA' includes other income (FY26 ₹1,717 cr; Q1FY27 ₹505 cr); Screener's EBITDA excludes it (FY26 ₹1,641 cr, Q1FY27 ₹468 cr). Screener's FY26 figure also includes the ₹76 cr one-time acquisition cost and ~₹24 cr moved from finance cost.
accounting.leases: Ind AS 116: lease liabilities ₹991 cr at Mar-26 (₹215 cr a year earlier; ₹708 cr came with PPG); lease payments ₹128 cr in FY26; contractual rent due within one year ₹162 cr. UK pre- vs post-IFRS EBITDA gap ~£2.4 mn a quarter.
accounting.ppa: PPG purchase price ₹2,201 cr: net assets ₹358 cr, customer intangibles ₹768 cr, brand ₹114 cr, deferred tax −₹221 cr, goodwill ₹1,181 cr. Amortisation ~£2.3 mn in the five FY26 months.
accounting.exceptional: FY26: labour-code charge ₹51 cr (exceptional); one-time PPG acquisition costs ₹76 cr (inside other expenses); Jammu write-down ₹6.2 cr (discontinued).
accounting.reclass: Q4FY26 reclassified Cayman doctor fees from professional fees to employee cost (professional fees looked negative that quarter); UK cost lines also reclassified in Q4.
accounting.tax: Effective tax 15.4% (FY25), 16.3% (FY26), 20.4% (Q1FY27); Cayman profits untaxed locally.
